exposure: earlier routine induction, i.e. between 41+3 and 41+5 GW
routine elective induction of labour at gestational week (GW) 42+0
Earlier routine induction of labour between 41+3 and 41+5 GW
Routine elective induction of labour at gestational week (GW) 42+0
cohort: All births in Denmark at 41+3 to 45+0 gestational weeks between 2000 and 2016 (N = 152,887)
finding: A more proactive regimen recommending induction of labour from GW 41+3 compared with 42+0 did not result in differences in neonatal outcomes including stillbirth, but significantly increased the rate of induction of labour and uterine rupture.
mod_finding: A proactive regimen recommending induction of labor from gestational week 41+3 compared to 42+0 did not result in differences in neonatal outcomes, but did lead to an increase in induced labor and uterine ruptures.
